SRC-305:R001.text: SAIPEN admission enforcement: a development Write/Edit or consequential Bash for SAIPEN-managed work must require an authoritative start/claim receipt and an active STATE-bound DOING owned by the actor BEFORE the first mutation. Retrospective phase replay is explicitly insufficient. Test a new request against phase:DONE task:none: tools refuse before claim, succeed after claim, and preserve non-mutating reads.
